query:
SELECT id, title, year, author_id, created_by FROM books
                 WHERE (?1 IS NULL OR author_id = ?1)
                   AND (?2 IS NULL OR instr(lower(title), lower(?2)) > 0)
                   AND (?3 IS NULL OR id > ?3)
                   AND (?4 IS NULL OR id < ?4)
                 ORDER BY id DESC
                 LIMIT ?5
